name: slider
description: A source-owned shadcn-style Slider for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned pointer-drag/keyboard value primitive. Pointer-drag interaction depends on the web feature (pointer tracking is a no-op on the native default); keyboard arrow-key interaction works on every target. Desktop pointer-capture behavior is compiled but not independently verified against a real desktop WebView, a named and recorded gap.
